title: Colonia — Corpus of Classical (Colonial) Portuguese
notes: Colonia is the diachronic corpus of classical Portuguese (16th-20th c.) of the AC/DC annotation project at Linguateca (Diana Santos). The live Linguateca author/works list for Colonia enumerates exactly the collected works — Anchieta, Pero Vaz de Caminha, Gandavo, Vieira sermons/letters, Camões, Guerr(a?)e(d)eiro, Melo. The corpus's own site (corporavm.uni-koeln.de/colonia) is dead; Linguateca's page remains the live official listing. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
institution: Linguateca / CorporaVM, corpus directed by Diana Santos
